author: DamiLee
description:
I'm a huge Wong Kar-wai fan, and so much of what makes his films look the way they do is the neon. You really can't get that look anywhere but Hong Kong.

But there isn't much of it left. One person has counted just over 400 neon signs still up across the city, and there are maybe eight or nine masters left who know how to bend the glass.

Some people are trying to keep it alive. Tetra Neon Exchange has rescued more than 60 signs, and Jive Lau is teaching the craft to a new generation.

Which film or show do you think captures Hong Kong the best?

#HongKong #WongKarWai #Neon #FallenAngels #ChungkingExpress
title: What Happened to Hong Kong's Neon?
